query:
SELECT c.id
            FROM conversations c
            JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT e.status
                FROM runtime_compaction_events e
                WHERE e.conversation_id = c.external_conversation_id
                ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ) latest ON TRUE
            WHERE c.bear_id = $1
              AND lower(latest.status) = 'skipped'
            ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
            LIMIT 25
